name: Grisandole

attributes.attribute: French heroine who took the name Grisandole
master whom Avenable served as seneschal

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Grisandole is the false name worn by Avenable, a French heroine. To win the post of seneschal to the Roman emperor, Avenable disguised herself as a man and carried this name. For the fuller account, see the entry for Avenable.

okr.objective: Cross-reference the name Grisandole to the heroine Avenable.
key_results: Grisandole is a name worn by Avenable.
Avenable disguised herself as a man to serve the Roman emperor as seneschal.
